from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def resolve_affine_calibration(groups: np.ndarray, check_groups: np.ndarray, check_command: np.ndarray, check_stress: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive: np.ndarray | None = None, span_fraction: float = 0.05, inlier_fraction: float = 0.0006, archive_fraction: float = 0.003) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return sorted numeric group labels and physical [gain, bias] rows.

    Commands, check stresses and the positive stress scale share units. Within
    a group the transfer is affine with positive gain. Archive rows have shape
    (epochs, groups, 2) in sorted label order; a nonfinite row is unavailable.
    Pair-seeded consensus requires three checks, a strict majority and command
    span > 0.05 of scale by default. The residual tolerances are 0.0006 for
    consensus and 0.003 for archive agreement, also fractions of scale.
    A selected archive gain is held fixed and only agreeing residuals update
    its bias. Without archive support, two distinct checks can determine an
    affine map but cannot establish robustness. Insufficient or conflicting
    evidence raises ValueError rather than assuming a calibration.
    """
    groups, cg = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(check_groups)
    x, y = np.asarray(check_command, float), np.asarray(check_stress, float)
    limits = [stress_scale, span_fraction, inlier_fraction, archive_fraction]
    if groups.ndim != 1 or not groups.size or x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or cg.shape != x.shape:
        raise ValueError('invalid group or check array shapes')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (groups, cg, limits)) or min(limits) <= 0:
        raise ValueError('need finite labels and positive calibration scales')
    labels = np.unique(groups)
    if np.any(~np.isin(cg, labels)):
        raise ValueError('checks must name a requested group')
    valid = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    x, y = x / stress_scale, y / stress_scale
    blocks = [(x[valid & (cg == g)], y[valid & (cg == g)]) for g in labels]
    out = np.empty((labels.size, 2))
    sparse = []
    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(blocks):
        a, b = np.triu_indices(len(u), 1)
        use = np.abs(u[b] - u[a]) > span_fraction
        a, b = a[use], b[use]
        slopes = (v[b] - v[a]) / (u[b] - u[a])
        masks = np.abs(v - v[a, None] - slopes[:, None] * (u - u[a, None])) <= inlier_fraction
        A = np.column_stack((u, np.ones(len(u))))
        best = None
        minimum = max(3, len(u) // 2 + 1)
        for mask in np.unique(masks[(slopes > 0) & (masks.sum(axis=1) >= minimum)], axis=0):
            p = np.linalg.lstsq(A[mask], v[mask], rcond=None)[0]
            residual = A @ p - v
            keep = np.abs(residual) <= inlier_fraction
            if p[0] <= 0 or keep.sum() < minimum or np.ptp(u[keep]) <= span_fraction:
                continue
            key = (-int(keep.sum()), np.linalg.norm(residual[keep]))
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, p)
        if best is not None:
            out[i] = best[1]
        else:
            pair = np.array([slopes[0], v[a[0]] - slopes[0] * u[a[0]]]) if len(u) == 2 and slopes.size and slopes[0] > 0 else None
            sparse.append((i, pair))
    if sparse:
        profiles = np.empty((0, labels.size, 2)) if archive is None else np.array(archive, dtype=float, copy=True)
        if profiles.ndim != 3 or profiles.shape[1:] != (labels.size, 2):
            raise ValueError('archive must have shape (epochs, groups, 2)')
        profiles[..., 1] /= stress_scale
        supported = np.isfinite(profiles).all(axis=-1) & (profiles[..., 0] > 0)
        scores = np.zeros(len(profiles))
        for i, (u, v) in enumerate(blocks):
            p = profiles[supported[:, i], i]
            err = np.abs(v - p[:, :1] * u - p[:, 1:])
            scores[supported[:, i]] += np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - err / archive_fraction).sum(axis=1)
        peak = scores.max(initial=0.0)
        winners = np.isclose(scores, peak, rtol=0.0, atol=1e-12) if peak > 0 else np.zeros(len(scores), bool)
        for i, pair in sparse:
            options = profiles[winners & supported[:, i], i]
            if len(options):
                p = options[0].copy()
                if not np.allclose(options, p, atol=1e-12, rtol=0.0):
                    raise ValueError(f'archive epochs disagree for group {labels[i]!r}')
                u, v = blocks[i]
                residual = v - (p[0] * u + p[1])
                agree = np.abs(residual) <= archive_fraction
                if agree.any():
                    p[1] += np.median(residual[agree])
                out[i] = p
            elif pair is not None:
                out[i] = pair
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'calibration is underdetermined for group {labels[i]!r}')
    out[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return labels, out


def align_coupon_panel(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return dimensionless aligned features and a row missingness mask.

    Comparable reference panels and signals share one offset and positive gain
    per group; rows share group and stratum labels. Use medians of reference
    column means and population standard deviations over columns with at least
    two finite points. No gain shrinkage is applied. Each observed group–stratum
    cell contributes one mean per supported feature to the global fill vector;
    a wholly unobserved feature is filled with zero at the reference origin.
    References may include unlabeled target rows when transductive alignment is intended.
    """
    raw, ref = np.asarray(raw, float), np.asarray(reference, float)
    groups, strata = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if raw.ndim != 2 or not all(raw.shape) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(raw) or groups.shape != (len(raw),) or strata.shape != groups.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references and labels must share a nonempty row axis')
    if not np.isfinite(groups).all() or not np.isfinite(strata).all():
        raise ValueError('group and stratum labels must be finite')
    present = np.isfinite(raw)
    out = np.empty_like(raw)
    cells = []
    for group in np.unique(groups):
        rows = groups == group
        block = ref[rows]
        block = block[:, np.isfinite(block).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        if not block.shape[1]:
            raise ValueError('each group needs a supported reference column')
        block = np.where(np.isfinite(block), block, np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(block, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(block, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
            raise ValueError('reference panel must have a finite center and positive scale')
        out[rows] = (np.where(present[rows], raw[rows], np.nan) - center) / scale
        for stratum in np.unique(strata[rows]):
            cell = out[rows & (strata == stratum)]
            count = np.isfinite(cell).sum(axis=0)
            cells.append(np.divide(np.nansum(cell, axis=0), count, out=np.full(raw.shape[1], np.nan), where=count > 0))
    cells = np.asarray(cells)
    count = np.isfinite(cells).sum(axis=0)
    fill = np.divide(np.nansum(cells, axis=0), count, out=np.zeros(raw.shape[1]), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(present, out, fill), ~present.all(axis=1)


def fit_history_coupled_hold(history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, baseline: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, curves: np.ndarray | None = None, rate: np.ndarray | None = None, parameters: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None, incomplete: np.ndarray | None = None, onset_anchor: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit or evaluate a two-mode hereditary hold with yield-activated terms.

    Calibrated signed stresses share the yield unit; histories run oldest first
    with shared interval durations and zero initial memory. Durations, hold
    times and tau bounds share a time unit. Features are dimensionless. Internal
    scales are yield stress, upper tau bound and observed response magnitude.
    A multi-start L2 initializer is followed by two soft-L1 passes with separate
    strain/rate MAD scales and a dimensionless floor of 2e-4. There is no
    coefficient ridge. Nonfinite observations are omitted, and unexcited
    plastic columns receive zero coefficients. Prediction with such coefficients
    does not establish transfer to an unobserved plastic regime.

    Return ordered taus, physical hereditary coefficients (two compliances,
    drift intercept and feature slopes), two plastic coefficients (hold, history),
    strain curves and the analytic t=0+ rate. Pass the first three outputs as
    parameters to evaluate without fitting. If supplied, incomplete and
    onset_anchor correct only the linear drift of marked rows having finite
    independent onset rates; this correction is never used to learn coefficients.
    """
    h, s, dt, t, x, base = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (history, hold, durations, times, features, baseline))
    if h.ndim != 2 or not len(h) or s.shape != (len(h),) or base.shape != s.shape or dt.shape != (h.shape[1],) or t.ndim != 1 or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != len(h):
        raise ValueError('incompatible hold array shapes')
    low, T = map(float, tau_bounds)
    Y = float(yield_stress)
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (h, s, dt, t, x, base, [low, T, Y])) or not 0 < low < T or Y <= 0 or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('need finite inputs, nonnegative times and positive physical scales')
    h, s, dt, t = h / Y, s / Y, dt / T, t / T
    n, k = len(h), len(t)
    end = np.zeros_like(dt)
    end[:-1] = np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1]
    over = np.maximum(np.abs(s) - 1.0, 0.0)**2 * np.sign(s)
    work = (np.maximum(np.abs(h) - 1.0, 0.0)**2 @ dt) * s
    time_rate = np.r_[t, 1.0]
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))[:, None, :] * time_rate[None, :, None]
    split = x.shape[1] + 3
    conversion = np.r_[Y, Y, np.full(x.shape[1] + 1, T), Y**2 * T, Y**3 * T]

    def design(logq: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        q = np.exp(logq)
        mode, dmode = [], []
        for a in q:
            elapsed = np.exp(-end / a)
            earlier = np.exp(-(end + dt) / a)
            w = elapsed * -np.expm1(-dt / a)
            dw = end / a * w - dt / a * earlier
            gap = s - h @ w
            kernel = np.r_[-np.expm1(-t / a), 1.0 / a]
            dk = -np.r_[(t / a) * np.exp(-t / a), 1.0 / a]
            mode.append(gap[:, None] * kernel)
            dmode.append(gap[:, None] * dk - (h @ dw)[:, None] * kernel)
        fast = q[0]
        history_kernel = np.r_[-np.expm1(-t / fast), 1.0 / fast]
        dhistory = -work[:, None] * np.r_[(t / fast) * np.exp(-t / fast), 1.0 / fast]
        mat = np.concatenate((np.stack(mode, axis=-1), drift,
                              (over[:, None] * time_rate)[..., None],
                              (work[:, None] * history_kernel)[..., None]), axis=-1)
        return mat, np.stack(dmode, axis=-1), dhistory

    if parameters is None:
        obs = np.full((n, k + 1), np.nan)
        if curves is not None:
            c = np.asarray(curves, float)
            if c.shape != (n, k):
                raise ValueError('curves must match rows and hold times')
            obs[:, :k] = c - base[:, None]
        if rate is not None:
            r = np.asarray(rate, float)
            if r.shape != (n,):
                raise ValueError('rate must have one entry per row')
            obs[:, k] = r * T
        good = np.isfinite(obs)
        target = obs[good]
        columns = np.r_[np.arange(split), split + np.flatnonzero([np.any(over), np.any(work)])]
        if target.size < columns.size + 2 or not np.any(target):
            raise ValueError('insufficient observations for two-mode inversion')
        response = max(np.median(np.abs(target)), 1e-6 * np.max(np.abs(target)))
        target = target / response
        is_rate = np.broadcast_to(np.arange(k + 1) == k, obs.shape)[good]
        L = np.log(low / T)
        lower = np.r_[0.0, 0.0, np.full(columns.size, -np.inf)]
        upper = np.r_[1.0, 1.0, np.full(columns.size, np.inf)]

        def ordered(ab: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            fast = L * (1.0 - ab[0])
            return np.array([fast, fast * (1.0 - ab[1])])

        def residual_jac(p: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
            logq = ordered(p[:2])
            full, dm, dw = design(logq)
            mat = full[good][:, columns]
            da = dm[good] * p[2:4]
            if columns[-1] == split + 1:
                da[:, 0] += dw[good] * p[-1]
            chain = np.array([[-L, 0.0], [-L * (1.0 - p[1]), -logq[0]]])
            return mat @ p[2:] - target, np.column_stack((da @ chain, mat)), np.column_stack((da, mat))

        def run(p: np.ndarray, scale: np.ndarray, loss: str):
            return least_squares(lambda v: residual_jac(v)[0] / scale, p,
                                 jac=lambda v: residual_jac(v)[1] / scale[:, None],
                                 bounds=(lower, upper), loss=loss, x_scale='jac',
                                 max_nfev=300, ftol=1e-9)

        scale = np.ones_like(target)
        pilots = []
        for ab in ((0.25, 0.55), (0.40, 0.65), (0.55, 0.70)):
            logq = ordered(np.asarray(ab))
            mat = design(logq)[0][good][:, columns]
            p0 = np.r_[ab, np.linalg.lstsq(mat, target, rcond=None)[0]]
            result = run(p0, scale, 'linear')
            if result.success:
                pilots.append(result)
        if not pilots:
            raise ValueError('two-mode initialization did not converge')
        p = min(pilots, key=lambda result: result.cost).x
        for _ in range(2):
            r = residual_jac(p)[0]
            for mask in (is_rate, ~is_rate):
                if mask.any():
                    v = r[mask]
                    scale[mask] = max(2e-4, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(v - np.median(v))))
            result = run(p, scale, 'soft_l1')
            if not result.success:
                raise ValueError('robust hold fit did not converge')
            p = result.x
        logq = ordered(p[:2])
        r, _, J = residual_jac(p)
        sv = np.linalg.svd(J / (scale * np.sqrt(np.hypot(1.0, r / scale)))[:, None], compute_uv=False)
        if -np.expm1(logq[0] - logq[1]) <= 0.001 or sv[-1] <= 1e-8 * sv[0]:
            raise ValueError('relaxation modes or active coefficients are not separately identifiable')
        beta = np.zeros(conversion.size)
        beta[columns] = response * p[2:]
        tau = T * np.exp(logq)
        coeff = beta / conversion
    else:
        tau, hereditary, plastic = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in parameters)
        if tau.shape != (2,) or hereditary.shape != (split,) or plastic.shape != (2,) or not low <= tau[0] < tau[1] <= T or not np.isfinite(np.r_[hereditary, plastic]).all():
            raise ValueError('need ordered bounded taus and matching finite physical coefficients')
        coeff = np.r_[hereditary, plastic]
        logq, beta = np.log(tau / T), coeff * conversion
    pred = design(logq)[0] @ beta
    if incomplete is not None or onset_anchor is not None:
        mask = np.asarray(incomplete, bool)
        anchor = np.asarray(onset_anchor, float)
        if mask.shape != (n,) or anchor.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('supply a missingness mask and onset value per row')
        use = mask & np.isfinite(anchor)
        pred[use, :k] += (anchor[use] * T - pred[use, k])[:, None] * t
        pred[use, k] = anchor[use] * T
    return tau, coeff[:split], coeff[split:], base[:, None] + pred[:, :k], pred[:, k] / T

    observed[::5, 4] = np.nan
    rates = onset.copy()
    rates[::7] = np.nan

    def fit(stress_factor, time_factor, idx):
        tau, w, p, curve, rate = fit_history_coupled_hold(
            h[idx] * stress_factor, s[idx] * stress_factor, dt * time_factor,
            t * time_factor, x[idx], base[idx], stress_factor,
            tuple(bounds * time_factor), curves=observed[idx], rate=rates[idx] / time_factor)
        assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (tau, w, p, curve, rate))
        check(tau / time_factor, q, rtol=2e-6)
        check(w * np.r_[[stress_factor] * 2, [time_factor] * 5], hereditary, rtol=2e-6)
        check(p * time_factor * stress_factor**np.array([2, 3]), plastic, rtol=2e-6)
        check(curve, clean[idx], atol=2e-8)
        check(rate * time_factor, onset[idx], atol=2e-8)
        return tau, w, p

    parameters = fit(1., 1., np.arange(n))
    fit(0.01, 0.5, rng.permutation(n))
    anchor = onset + 0.037
    anchor[1] = np.nan
    _, _, _, corrected, corrected_rate = fit_history_coupled_hold(
        h, s, dt, t, x, base, 1., tuple(bounds), parameters=parameters,
        incomplete=np.arange(n) < 2, onset_anchor=anchor)
    check(corrected[0], clean[0] + 0.037 * t, atol=2e-8)
    check(corrected[1:], clean[1:], atol=2e-8)
    check(corrected_rate, np.r_[anchor[0], onset[1:]], atol=2e-8)

    hs, ss = np.clip(h, -1., 1.), np.clip(s, -1., 1.)
    expected, first = truth(hs, ss, plastic)
    ts, ws, ps, cs, rs = fit_history_coupled_hold(
        hs, ss, dt, t, x, base, 1., tuple(bounds), curves=expected, rate=first)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(ps, [0., 0.])
    check(ts, q, rtol=2e-6)
    check(ws, hereditary, rtol=2e-6)
    check(cs, expected, atol=2e-8)
    check(rs, first, atol=2e-8)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        fit_history_coupled_hold(hs, ss, dt, t, np.column_stack((x, x[:, 0])),
                                 base, 1., tuple(bounds), curves=expected, rate=first)


run_self_test()
"
